name: madison
description: Work Madison tickets with your agent: set up your team's rules, write up Problems, Bugs, Initiatives and Tasks, make an Initiative's design in your team's design tool, review Tasks before they are built, pick up a ticket, answer an open question that needs evidence with a spike, check whether an old one is still relevant, explore the code, get a second opinion, then build, verify and ship it your team's way, and run a retro once an Initiative is Done. Every decision lands on the ticket.
